node.statement: Write d=D*t. From epsilon_R <= t and t <= W.r_reset <= e_it/(D+1), one has d+epsilon_R <= (D+1)*t <= e_it. The raw-call hypotheses also supply that B_R is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra, A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra, and u_R is an extended d-inclusion.
